name: True Raptor
description: Finally a chicken realized their collective dream of becoming a dinosaur again.

name: Truefire Phoenix
description: No matter how long the road, it is always ready to ride.

name: TRUMP3T
description: Music that moves you.

name: Trundling Boom Bundle
description: Just roll it to wherever the explosions need to happen, preferrably with you not still on it.

name: Tundra Thresher
description: This surefooted saurian scoffs at glaciers and snowy steppes.

name: Tundra Thunderer
description: Break the ice with this massive glacier gorer.

name: Turbo Duck
description: A long time ago, a baby duckling witnessed Ganda bolting overhead chased by a pack of shadows, and a legend was born.

name: Turkey Throne
description: Grab the head seat at the feast table and get ready to chow down.

name: Turtle Tank
description: Never trapped for long, this amphibious friend can shell any target, whether on land or at sea.

name: Twigler
description: That fire can't be safe, can it?!

name: Twilight Stalker
description: Though shy and secretive, these beasts can occasionally be found roaming the surface of Geode.

name: Twitching Tentacle
description: How it twitches, writhes and struggles, as if with purpose yet unfulfilled...

name: Ty's Awesomerion Ride
description: Take the terrific Tysorion option!

name: Tyke Present Trike
description: Woven from snow, shadow, and the combined love and effort of Qubesly, the Delver's Guild, and Trovians like you!

name: Typhandir, the Sundered Shield
description: Haunted by some great, unspoken loss he languishes deaf to the cries of the downtrodden.\n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +10% Max Health, +7% Attack Speed and +50 Magic Find.

name: Tysorion's Throne
description: It's not big enough for THE Tysorion, but it's a lovely throne nonetheless.

name: Tysorion, Steward of New Beginnings
description: His duty is to witness the birth of new worlds, wherever they may arise. \n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +0.3% Critical Hit, +3% Critical Damage, +1000 Max Health, +250 Physical Damage and +50 Magic Find.

name: Tysplation
description: Tries hard to not destroy new worlds with each splat.

name: Uncanny Coffin
description: Spread the holiday haunts aboard this bewitched casket.

name: Unhurried Undertow
description: Don't stray too far from shore, lest you be dragged down below... Slowly. Very, very slowly.

name: Uni-Cycle
description: A sleek riding machine inspired by the most coveted mythological mount.

name: United Airflier
description: Started out as an experiment but became a huge success together!

name: Unveiled Chameleon
description: It appears to have shed its camouflage abilities in favor of increased size.

name: Urmhalit, the Unforgiven
description: Banished from Dragonfire Peaks after succumbing to the curse of Balefire, he journeyed to the Everdark seeking absolution or death\n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +1% Critical Hit and +50 Magic Find.

name: Ursa Major
description: Definitely too big to make the cute baby bear face, but will still try.

name: Vaentaera, the Perpetual
description: Be it struggle, dance, hoist, or yoke, the interplay between Matter and Energy matches forever onward in this MAG-nificent specimen.\n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +3 Energy Regeneration, +1000 Max Health, and +50 Magic Find.

name: Valkartzer, Dragon Magrider
description: Ruling the rails for ten thousand years.

name: Valkizer, King of Dragons
description: Zehira herself appointed him to rule for ten thousand years.

name: Vault Vulture
description: High above the city swoops a feathered felon, talons locked on a stolen safe and eyes on its next shiny score.

name: Venturine Signatory Rug
description: Lord Primalux's favorite pattern.

name: Venturine Vroomer
description: Faster than any red car! Within the Luxion's realms, of course.

name: Verlis Wolf
description: A likeable lupine with an affinity for finding and collecting eclectic companions.

name: Vernon, Wizened and Fair
description: Though owner to many nicknames, he's partial to 'Wise Vern', as named by his Trovian allies.

name: Very Berry Tartle
description: Toasted well so it never gets soggy.

name: Vile Slime
description: Not very comfortable to sit on.

name: Vitamin Velocity
description: A fruitful journey awaits.

name: Void Crypt
description: Drowned in Void's darkness, sending you closer to your grave.

name: Volatile Bounder
description: A blast to bounce along on, especially when it goes boom!

name: Wakling Waddlemum
description: Unless she trusts you, never get between a Waddlemum and her Brood.

name: Walden
description: Walden generally tries to walk on marked paths (except when visiting Candoria).

name: Walk n Jam
description: Crank up the volume and strut through the halls like it's 1995. Rewind not included.

name: Wanda
description: Not a fish...or a fan of the water.

name: War Horse
description: This means war.

name: War Plane
description: Fly in style.

name: Warden W.A.L.T.
description: The preferred ride of the W.A.L.T. division.

name: Warpainted Javelina
description: This painted piggy is prepped for combat.

name: Watchful Spaceguard
description: Your personal bodyguard, ready to protect you from any space debris or asteroid dangers!

name: Watt's Saucer
description:
A magnificent example of alien technology, but how did Watt fit in this?
Flies freely in the Sundered Uplands

name: Wayfaring Warbear
description: With that chunk of Permafrost ice on his collar, he never feels far from home.

name: Web Surfer
description: Everyone's best friend for playing the best games and finding the best cat videos.

name: Wee-Woo Sheep
description: This woolly law enforcer charges the beat with flashing lights and a resounding baaaaa that means business.

name: Well-Travelled Treasure Chest
description: Damaged during a frightful frigate battle, it still keeps a tight lid on all its loot.

name: Weyrfir, Winter's Rest
description: Silent and somber, he quiets the earth in a blanket of frost.

name: Whacky Waffle
description: Not quite syrup-and-sriracha cray, but quickly headed that way.

name: Wheel of Fundue
description: Rats! Don't cut any more of this cheese.

name: Whelp of the Fall
description: Dancing underneath the rainy skies.

name: Whirlygig
description: WARNING: Do not ride if pregnant or in poor cardiovascular health. If you experience dizziness, irregular heartbeat, or blurred vision dismount immediately and consult a physician.

name: Whistlebeak
description: No fouls, no flakes, and absolutely no funny business on the ice!

name: Whyvern
description: Known for asking 'Why, Vern?' over and over again.

name: Wild C.A.T.
description: Take on the toughest terrain with this feral fighting feline.

name: Wiley Wolf
description: May have been the result of a coyote's machinations.

name: Willow of the Wintercoat
description: Hello, new friend! IS THAT SNOW? I am never coming inside again.

name: Willow Woodsworth
description: Woodsworth the fourth, carving many Trovian paths.

name: Willowback Hedgerunner
description: Part hedge, part hog, all garden.

name: Windboard
description: Tends to get a bit blown away.

name: Winter Dragon
description: Unlocked through consumption of 50 Winter Dragon Souls, craftable at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub.

name: Winter Fledgling
description: Unlocked through consumption of 10 Winter Dragon Souls, craftable at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub.

name: Winter Pinata
description: Always a great +1 at seasonal family gatherings.

name: Wizardly Wyvern
description: Because Dragons just weren't magical enough.

name: Wondrous Winter Leaf
description: Magically preserved by an expert gardener.\n\nWondrous Winter Leaf is a Gardening badge reward.

name: Woodland Wuzelthorn
description: Soaring between the fall trees in search of runaway Wuzzles.

name: Wyntegra, Galenor's Pride
description: Daughter of Permafrost's Primarch, she has become adept at both stewarding the domain and serving abroad as its most trusted ambassador\n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +3% Critical Damage, +500 Physical Damage and +50 Magic Find.

name: Wyrdwind Voltergeist
description: Some Kami eventually lose themselves to hatred, despair, or loneliness, venting their fury indiscriminately.

name: Xendri, the Arc Tempest
description: Crackling with energy, this fabled stormbringer electrifies the clouds as he tears through the skies. \n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +10 Maximum Energy, +3% Energy Regeneration, +1000 Max Health, and +50 Magic Find.

name: Yaba-nata Pinata
description: Smart and mischievous.

name: Yabaki, the Cast Shadow
description: ...There, humbled before the Sun Goddess, Cygnus finally shed his doubts, but they had been deep-rooted and took on a life of their own...

name: Yabasquee
description: The condensed and squishy form of the Sun Goddess' doubts.

name: Ye Old Cannon Bike
description: Just the right vehicle for when you need to be blasting off elsewhere.

name: Yoked Yolk
description: ...but 'Yo-Yo' for short

name: Yongari, Broker of Secrets
description: Always knows a guy who knows a guy, keeping tabs on the pulse of Luminopolis on behalf of Hoshizora.

name: Yorinn, the Dusk Shadow
description: With the twilight comes silent Yorinn, and the birds cease their songs and settle for the night. \n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +10% Critical Damage and +50 Magic Find.

name: Yzzuli of the Honeybreeze
description: She can often be found catnapping in sun-kissed meadows amid swarms of enraptured bees, much to Petallura's amusement.\n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +250 Damage, +5% Attack Speed, and +50 Magic Find.

name: Za'Hadeen, Heart of the Flame
description: Keeper of the Worldfire, and able to channel its power at will. Attacks more quickly than other dragons and press attack and hold while in the air to continuously shoot.\n\nOnce unlocked, grants 10% increase to power rank from Fire Gems.

name: Zeuztian, the Eternal Irradiance
description: Having stolen Light from the furnace of the sun, Zeuztian abhors the shadow and seeks its destruction at all costs.\n\nHaving this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +25 Light, and +50 Magic Find.

name: Zombie Pemblock
description: Pemblock but the dead version. You get it.

name: Zyntryn, the Fury
description:
Zyntryn is always first into the fray and not one to shy from a challenge.

Having this Dragon unlocked grants a permanent +1000 Max Health, +10% Critical Damage, +5 Jump, and +50 Magic Find.
